scope: formal single-phase steady Route A matrix execution/evaluation only

contract_hash.expected_digest_location: docs/routeA_execution_contract.md; external to hashed JSON to avoid self-reference
contract_hash.start_guard: before any case generation/mesh/solver, hash this JSON and compare to the frozen digest; also verify implementation and template hashes
contract_hash.amendment: no in-place post-result edits; separate amendment with reason/date/user authorization and new version/hash

supersedes.only: historical D unresolved detail and execution scheduling; this newer contract fixes D and explicitly permits preregistered continuation within cap
preserves: F/G nonblocking matrix collection with documented limitations
A-SMOKE remains smoke; existing accepted status unchanged

frozen_model.algorithm: PIMPLE dictionary, steady SIMPLE mode, nOuterCorrectors=1
frozen_model.spatial_schemes: Gauss linear; Gauss linear orthogonal; linear interpolation; orthogonal snGrad
frozen_model.Ra_generation: g=Ra*nu0*alpha0/(beta*DeltaT*L^3); do not use rounded displayed g

template_source.numerical_model_consistency: PASS against template and both existing minimal cases
template_source.laminar_Stokes: runtime-selected Stokes from existing implementation audit; dictionary simulationType laminar; do not add a new stress-model entry

purpose: hot-only formal Nu_bar_0 Rwin, legacy pair average retained as legacy
exact OLS heat-slope sign from original decimal Q tokens
reusable residual parser with initial/final/corrector distinction and duplicate/nonfinite rejection
formal monitor Nu_bar_0 column every iteration; separate path1 snapshot column
segment-start and solver-log arguments for preregistered continuation

execution.iteration_cap_rule: all 12 primary cases: 30000 absolute iterations from time 0
execution.reason: simple common budget; 3000 matches minimal cases and divides monitor/write cadences; 30000 accommodates B fine 18000-21000 experience but guarantees neither A convergence nor Gate PASS
execution.continuation_rule: after each sealed normal finite segment: Gate D PASS -> accepted and finish case; Gate D FAIL and end<cap -> same-case restart +3000; Gate D FAIL at cap -> CONVERGENCE_NOT_REACHED, computed YES accepted NO, continue next case
continuation_allowed_failures: positive heat slope in a finite normal result
execution.state: single primary solution path, no cold restart/re-generation after an unsuccessful checkpoint
execution.input_hash_rule: initial case_manifest immutable; archive a per-segment controlDict hash and exact two-key planned diff; every other input/model/mesh hash must remain unchanged
execution.restart_state_guard: latestTime must equal previous sealed checkpoint; previous fields/mesh/hash must match; initialize/OQ-02 at initial state only, not p_rgh=0 at evolved restart

monitor.expected_velocity_iterations: multiples of 10 inside inclusive window: N-190,...,N
monitor.velocity_monitor_interpolation: existing sets cellPointFace on exact X=0.5 / Z=0.5 lines; max U_x on vertical.xy, max U_y on horizontal.xy; convert by L/alpha0
monitor.velocity_final_interpolation: existing analysis: two bracketing cell rows/columns to exact centreline, then 4097 points including no-slip endpoints
monitor.restart_window: never crosses segments; minimum 200 fresh iterations; scheduled increments are 3000, so final window is entirely in latest segment; do not interpolate missing samples or merge duplicate restart iterations

source_selection.residuals: immutable log of the selected segment

Gate_D.boolean_logic: NORMAL_EXIT AND NO_FATAL_OR_NAN AND INPUT_PROVENANCE_PASS AND QOI_RWIN_PASS AND RESIDUAL_PASS AND HEAT_TREND_PASS
Gate_D.NORMAL_EXIT: actual process exit_code=0 AND standalone ^End line for the selected segment
Gate_D.NO_FATAL_OR_NAN: no fatal/FPE/nonfinite/divergence evidence during entire selected segment; final T,U,e(if stored),rho,p,p_rgh,phi and monitor values finite; missing mandatory fields or safety checks -> evaluator/provenance failure, STOP
Gate_D.INPUT_PROVENANCE_PASS: actual env/model/BC/properties/gravity/grid/input hashes match frozen generated/per-segment manifests; Gate A mesh/OQ-02 evidence intact

RESIDUAL_PASS.active_velocity: Ux,Uy (physical vertical is OpenFOAM y, paper Z); Uz inactive in 2D empty mesh
RESIDUAL_PASS.within_iteration: maximum Initial residual among every solve/corrector for each field; NOT the final linear-solver residual
RESIDUAL_PASS.parser: parse_residual_lines; parse_residuals streams segment file through the same parser
RESIDUAL_PASS.final_linear_residuals: record separately for diagnostics, never substitute for Initial

save: max absolute/relative solver rho minus EOS rho
native corrected mass flux continuity diagnostics
density.thermo_rho_rule: EOS-derived thermo density is the available comparison proxy; do not claim an independent thermo-rho registry dump was stored; unavailable independent evidence explicitly NOT_AVAILABLE

Nu_monitor_identity.formal_definition: Nu_bar_0 = Q_hot/(k*DeltaT*W) = L/(DeltaT*A_hot) integral_hot dT/dn dA on uniform orthogonal wall
Nu_monitor_identity.area: A_hot=L*W; Q is area integral, not area-mean q or volume mean
Nu_monitor_identity.wall_convection: no-slip wall, normal convective flux zero; paper Nu_bar_0 at X=0 is conductive only
Nu_monitor_identity.legacy_pair_average: (Q_hot-Q_cold)/(2*k*DeltaT*W) retained only as legacy diagnostic, never formal Hard monitor
Nu_monitor_identity.path1: temperature/orthogonal wall-gradient snapshot remains independent primary final-value path; gate monitor uses calibrated official path2
Nu_monitor_identity.normalization_precision: same generated property values and k*DeltaT*W as canonical implementation, supplied via str(float) to rational monitor arithmetic

HEAT_TREND_PASS.input: original 17-significant-digit Q_hot/Q_cold decimal tokens from physical wallHeatFlux
HEAT_TREND_PASS.arithmetic: Python Fraction from original decimal Q tokens; exact rational normalization, centering, accumulation and sign
HEAT_TREND_PASS.source_precision: scientific tokens with >=16 digits after decimal; existing .16e has 17 significant digits; controlDict writePrecision 16 unchanged
HEAT_TREND_PASS.display: float slope is display only; heat_slope_sign_exact governs PASS/FAIL, including underflow-to-zero display
HEAT_TREND_PASS.ambiguity: missing/duplicate samples, nonfinite/low-precision Q, bad sign or parser error -> HEAT_TREND_EVALUATOR_UNRESOLVED / EVALUATOR_FAILURE and STOP; never use endpoints only or a positive epsilon

statuses.COMPUTED: normal finite solver exit and field/metrics/provenance artifacts saved; result need not satisfy Gate D numerical thresholds
statuses.ACCEPTED: COMPUTED AND formal Gate D PASS; applies per row, not global benchmark PASS
statuses.evaluator_failure: UNRESOLVED/EVALUATOR_FAILURE, batch STOP; not an ordinary Gate D FAIL
statuses.Gate_E_F_G_evaluation: unaccepted data remain diagnostic; do not promote downstream formal accepted-only assessments

STOP: input/model/hash mismatch beyond registered between-segment control keys
CONTINUE: finite normal formal Gate D FAIL: preregistered continuation until cap, then next case
batch_stop_policy.divergence: divergence notification or loss of finite/admissible state; stationary residual floor or positive finite heat slope alone is a threshold miss, not automatically divergence
batch_stop_policy.failure_tuning_rule: save result and category, then separate user-decision diagnostic task; no automatic changes

Gate_F.nonmonotonic: retain FAIL/needs_320 YES and null p/GCI; if upstream unaccepted, retain NOT_EVALUATED and diagnostic-only trend

native_mass_flux.name: A_native_mass_phi
native_mass_flux.operator: corrected phi face balance / cell volume, same fvc::div(phi) diagnostic as minimal implementation
native_mass_flux.legacy_alias: epsilon_m; retain with explicit operator metadata

reconstructed_volume.name: A_reconstructed_U_divergence
reconstructed_volume.operator: Gauss linear from cell-centred U, physical no-slip walls, empty faces contribute zero, volume weighting V_i/sum(V)
reconstructed_volume.legacy_alias: epsilon_v; retain with explicit operator metadata

continuity.mass_versus_volume: separate operators and units; never copy B epsilon_phi name; no new phi/rhof operator study
continuity.zero_velocity: Ra0 uses Gate C absolute velocity criterion; relative divergence indicators null
continuity.symmetry: existing design §13.2: 180-degree matched uniform cells, theta(X,Z)+theta(1-X,1-Z)-1; U(X,Z)+U(1-X,1-Z). Volume L2 divided by max(volume RMS of theta or dimensionless velocity,1e-12); existing 0.2% criterion unchanged

energy_diagnostics.full_energy_budget_status: NOT_EVALUATED by wall imbalance alone; do not infer total transient energy conservation
energy_diagnostics.Gate_J_handoff: reuse raw fluxes, fields and provenance; J must include energy storage/work, EOS resynchronization and closed-cavity total mass; no energy-term study added here

AB_comparison.scalar_definition: D_AB=abs(Q_A-Q_B)/abs(Q_B) for nonzero B; signed differences separately
AB_comparison.zero_baseline_policy: relative difference null with ABSOLUTE_ONLY status; freeze existing scale if relative normalization is needed before execution
AB_comparison.primary_Nu: cell-volume U*theta quadrature plus imposed-wall conductive integral 1
AB_comparison.velocity_sampling: exact centrelines, linear interpolation, 4097 points including no-slip endpoints
AB_comparison.monitor_velocity_sampling: legacy 257 points / every 10 iterations; distinguish from final 4097-point QoIs
AB_comparison.local_Nu: raw faces and fixed five-point quartic/endpoint extrapolation separately
AB_comparison.operator_difference: A section uses reconstructed U_f; B section uses native corrected volume phi; identical continuum QoI but distinct discrete operators
AB_comparison.canonical_B_rows: only accepted YES for accepted comparisons; Ra1e6 labelled diagnostic B baseline
AB_comparison.missing_B_master_columns: Nu_half/Nu_1/positions/local Nu/section histories not fully in master CSV; obtain existing canonical outputs read-only in future, never invent/recompute B formal statuses
AB_comparison.postprocessing_version: dvd-nusselt-post-v2.1 for unchanged final QoI definitions; gate_D_evaluation_version stored separately
AB_comparison.operator_rule: LIKE_FOR_LIKE=NO for different operator/unit/sampling definitions; direct Hard comparison prohibited; retain native diagnostic interpretations and no AB Hard threshold
AB_comparison.missing_or_near_zero_B: relative difference null/ABSOLUTE_ONLY; no new near-zero threshold; if denominator distinguishability is unresolved set comparison NOT_EVALUATED rather than invent cutoff
AB_comparison.positions: absolute coordinate differences; signed differences separate
AB_comparison.scalar_gap: abs(A-B)/abs(B) for matched nonzero comparable B
AB_comparison.canonical_B: accepted YES rows for accepted comparison; Ra1e6 unaccepted explicitly diagnostic only; read existing missing columns only, never rewrite B

case_generation.invocation: --case-id A-SMOKE --name <formal case_id> --nx N --ny N --ra Ra --end-time 3000; allocate a NEW distinct case from canonical generator, never reuse A-SMOKE fields
case_generation.metadata_mapping: generator CLI accepts only minimal role IDs. Before any mesh/solver, preserve raw generator manifest as generated_manifest_original.json, relabel NEW case_manifest.case_id to the planned formal ID, record generator_role=A-SMOKE, contract version/hash, and source generator hash. Metadata only: no generated OpenFOAM input changed. Initial input_sha256 dictionary remains authoritative.
case_generation.reject: existing destination, unexpected Ra/grid/role/model, missing or mismatched generated hashes
case_generation.initial_state: U=0,T=T0; cell p=rho0*gh+pRef; physical walls p=rho(T_patch)*gh+pRef; constructor p_rgh=0 checked separately
case_generation.initialization: existing prepare_initialization_check.py isolated clone plus existing verify_initialization.py, all cells and 4 physical walls; after generated mesh and BEFORE first primary solve; existing 1-iteration initialization method, no new microcase
case_generation.initial_auxiliary_runs: one existing constructor-check clone per new case, only in future authorized execution task; not a matrix accepted row
case_generation.run_case_sh: do not use as a blind batch/continuation runner: it regenerates mesh and does not interpose explicit initialization verification; future task executes its canonical steps separately with hash/verify guards
case_generation.analysis_command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 Scripts/routeA/analyze_case.py CASE --segment-start S --solver-log IMMUTABLE_SEGMENT_LOG
case_generation.continuation_no_generation: no generator/blockMesh/initialization clone on continuation; restart sealed latestTime only

artifacts.current_case_status: updated atomically only after a segment directory and checksums are sealed; latest accepted checkpoint or cap failure; aggregate case status after each case, never wait for entire trio

artifacts.no_placeholder_values: missing metric/comparison is null with reason, never zero/PASS
